### deficiency_ext_restart_down_payment (computes amount_usd; tool pay_restart_down_payment_04892a83, owner user)
- Rule scope sentence + replaced_by ("…a new plan also requires a restart down payment, figured … on the balance on the day it is figured and collected as a payment on the account that carries no arrangement; an account without … needs no restart down payment") → hub restart_down_payment_collection_920b8f94 "Policy" paragraph + table + Q&A. Equivalent.
- Baseline rule "plan_restart_down_payment_pct percent of the balance on the day it is figured, rounded half up" + default 10.0 in every band → computation doc restart_down_payment_calculation_a40271e2 ("10.0% in every Deficiency Resolution Band"). Complete; no factor named.
- Assembly ("percentage points that schedules take off are added together … only then is any amount a schedule adds put on top") → same computation doc "Order of the figures" + worksheet lines; verbatim in substance.
- Latest-broken-arrangement definition → computation doc + restart_run_relief + restart_make_good. Equivalent.
- Factors (full ladder each):
  - hardship_relief → restart_hardship_relief_86449945: 3.0 (SSA or medical) / 1.5 (unemployment only) / 0; 12 whole-month look-back, whole-month convention, any offer kind/status. Complete.
  - surrender_relief → restart_surrender_relief_7563c77a: voluntary+key 2.0 / voluntary no key 1.0 / otherwise 0; names Repossession and Collateral Recovery case, recovery method and key field. Complete, findable from the recovery case words.
  - broken_run_relief → restart_run_relief_e83f0039: ≥9 → 2.0, 4-8 → 1.0, else 0; accepted_at→broken_date whole months. Complete.
  - contract_history_relief → restart_contract_history_relief_1d15069f: ≥24 → 1.0, 12-23 → 0.5, else 0; installment-type payments less returns on the liquidated contract under Retail Installment Contracts. Complete, findable from the contract ledger words.
  - make_good_addition (method) → restart_make_good_a81615fd: returns in 12 whole months → add their total; else latest break ≤90 days → add its installment_amount_usd; else nothing; added after rounding; rows in order. Complete.
- Tool contract (owner user, params, effect "carrying no arrangement", latest payment date today, receipt fields) → hub "How the payment is taken"; matches task_tools.py docstring and the unlock schema. Equivalent.
- prerequisite: [] — the hub carries no prerequisite sentence. Correct.

### deficiency_ext_plan_installment (computes installment_amount_usd; tool record_payment_plan_offer_3f4fb3a9, owner agent)
- replaced_by / rule sentence 1 → hub plan_offer_recording_535b6a7f "Policy" paragraph: "…figured on the balance on the day the offer is made, by the method of this policy, in place of the greater of the two minimums on the balance on the acceptance date; a balance below that smallest eligible balance keeps the small-balance terms, and the number of installments and the due dates stay as stated for every plan." Source says "by the standard method and the adjustment schedules of this policy"; the KB compresses to "by the method of this policy". Every schedule is carried in its own factor document, so the permitted results are unchanged — equivalent at the level of entailment (note N1).
- **Prerequisite (state form)** policy_source "When the account had a broken arrangement in the rolling 12 months, the monthly installment of a new plan is fixed only after the account's ledger carries the restart down payment, posted after the latest broken date as a payment that carries no arrangement." → verbatim in plan_offer_recording_535b6a7f (the blocked policy's hub), connective "only after" and state form intact; same-form restatement in the hub's table row. grep over all 6 published product corpora: the sentence appears in no other document. Resolution basis: the depended-on hub restart_down_payment_collection describes the write in the sentence's words ("collected as a payment on the account that carries no arrangement"; tool "posted on the account's ledger on today's date as a self-service bank payment carrying no arrangement"); records = broken offer 2026-08-12 + ledger with no later posting. Strength equal (hard gate). The depended-on documents do not carry the blocked sentence.
- "A plan offer states no down payment of its own; …never a term of the offer" → hub paragraph + Q&A. Equivalent.
- Baseline (standard = greatest of three, rounded up) + band figures → computation doc plan_installment_calculation_94c0a999. Complete.
- Assembly sentence (replace first; adjustments summed, signs; multiply once; raise to min and term floor; round up at end) → same doc "Order of the figures", verbatim in substance.
- Factors:
  - installment_basis_method (method) → plan_installment_basis_d1d59467: row 1 (SSA/medical/unemployment on an offer < 12 whole months) → balance/max term; row 2 (no such offer; latest broken payment plan < 12 whole months and ran ≥ 6) → greater of standard and that plan's installment; row 3 standard. Complete, incl. "Only payment-plan offers are read for the second line".
  - rebreak_surcharge → plan_rebreak_surcharge_7f165285: <6 → 10.0, 6-11 → 5.0, else 0; plan or settlement. Complete.
  - returned_surcharge → plan_returned_payment_surcharge_db15d381: ≥2 → 8.0, 1 → 4.0, 0 → none. Complete.
  - paydown_reduction → plan_paydown_reduction_1f940036: ≥0.4 → 6.0, 0.2-<0.4 → 3.0, else 0; posted + credits − returns over original deficiency. Complete.
  - credit_tier_surcharge → plan_credit_tier_surcharge_7341d020: Tier 6 5.0 / Tier 5 2.5 / others none (all six tiers listed); liquidated contract under Retail Installment Contracts. Complete.
  - recent_payer_reduction → plan_recent_payer_reduction_da94bd16: ≥2 → 4.0, 1 → 2.0, else 0; returns by own date. Complete.
- Tool contract → hub "Recording the offer"; matches docstring/unlock schema (count = balance/installment rounded up; no hardship document; offered).

Source-side item S1 (parameter label carrying the retired installment basis) is carried faithfully and reported in _difficulty.md. No previous revision.

- Depended-on side (restart_down_payment_collection, restart_down_payment_calculation, restart factor docs): no copy of the blocked sentence; no name of record_payment_plan_offer_3f4fb3a9; the hub's mention that "a new payment plan requires" the restart down payment is the source rule's own sentence (N2).

- Titles are general subjects ("Payment Plan Offers on Deficiency Balance Accounts: System Reference", "Restart Down Payment on Deficiency Balance Accounts: Collection Reference Card"); none mirrors Renata Szabo's situation.
- The depended-on document is reachable through the words the sentence and the records use ("restart down payment", "payment that carries no arrangement", broken arrangement).
- Factor documents state ladders as rules; none says which tier customers fall on, none names the computation document or another factor; computation documents carry no "unless/adjustments may apply" hint beyond the source assembly sentence (N3).
- Blind hop mark: state-derived (no pre-solved hop).
**PASS.**
